species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 48°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 6–20 ft deep, mostly on wind-blown banks.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 45 ft, cold below.
Northeast wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
